seo.title: AITS Wash | Professional Truck Washing for Commercial Fleets
seo.description: AITS Wash is a professional, standardized and digital truck wash built for India's commercial trucks, with water treatment and recycling.

hero.title: A professional wash infrastructure built specifically for commercial fleets.
hero.imageAlt: Concept illustration of a planned AITS Wash facility with a wash bay and water treatment plant

system.title: Designed for the diversity of Indian commercial trucks.

steps.title: Vehicle Scanner
steps.text: 3D Camera / LiDAR / Ultrasonic: maps truck dimensions and body configuration

steps.title: Vehicle Profile Engine
steps.text: Identifies dimensions, body type, cabin height, and vulnerable zones

steps.title: Safety Analysis
steps.text: Flags tarpaulins, wooden sideboards, spare tyres, custom bumpers

steps.title: PLC Control
steps.text: Configures washing sequence per vehicle profile

steps.title: Wash System
steps.text: Runs the wash sequence for that vehicle

diversity.title: Built for India's Truck Diversity
diversity.imageAlt: Front of a hand-painted Indian goods truck with a decorated cabin

water.title: The wash system and water system are designed as one infrastructure.

items.title: Planned WTP: 30 KLD
items.text: Water Treatment Plant capacity, a planned infrastructure target

items.title: Reduce Freshwater Demand
items.text: Recovered water re-enters the wash cycle

items.title: Treat Wash Wastewater
items.text: Solids, oils and particulates separated before reuse

water.note: Specific water-saving percentages are subject to engineering validation.

driver.title: AITS improves the experience for the driver.

journey.title: Rest & Refresh
journey.text: Use rest area and grab snacks

cta.title: Running a fleet?
cta.text: AITS Wash is built for recurring fleet contracts with one consolidated monthly invoice.
